videos.title: Jensen Huang is back as Nvidia’s CEO
videos.description: Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as its CEO. In the wake of his departure, more than 200,000 people, including Tesla CEO Elon Musk, Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan, and Uber co-founder Travis Kalanick, signed a letter to Nvidia’s board, calling for his reinstatement. Nvidia shares tumbled in Huang’s absence, while industry analysts raised concerns about an outsider replacing him at a time when Nvidia is so critical to the AI boom. videos.description:
Mike Schur is the driving force behind some of the great TV comedies, from Parks & Recreation to Brooklyn Nine-Nine to Man On The Inside to The Good Place. Now he’s back, with a new show called Dig. He joins the show to explain why first episodes matter more than ever, why a mystery can help a comedy, the kinds of shows that get made in 2026, and much more.
